crossRefs.note: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you)…
For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in…
So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the…
Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

translations.web: But I have sent the brothers that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
translations.bsb: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.
translations.kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
translations.asv: But I have sent the brethren, that our glorying on your behalf may not be made void in this respect; that, even as I said, ye may be prepared:
